title: Atomic requirement (REQ) front-matter
description: Deterministic contract for one intake-scoped requirement under specs/intakes/INTK-####/requirements/INTK-####-REQ-###.md.

source_file.description: Path to the evidence document under intake/ (validator also checks it exists on disk).

intake_batch.description: The intake batch (a registry id in intake/_index.md) whose documents this requirement was extracted from. Written at intake (Phase 1); the validator checks it is registered.

requirement_group.description: Exactly one non-governing business capability/process group from this intake's requirement-groups.yml. This classification never replaces the REQ's evidence provenance or dictates feature boundaries.

location.description: Where in the source the requirement was found (page / slide / cell / section).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source file, lowercase hex.

confidence.description: Extraction confidence. 'low' is well-formed but the validator emits a warning for the human reviewer.

title.description: Concise evidence-grounded title written during intake extraction.

status.description: conventions.yml status_flow, forward-only. Required as 'draft' during intake extraction.

depends_on.description: Acyclic dependency ids, completed in Phase 2.

grounding.description: Microsoft Learn (or other authoritative) URLs backing the criteria.

nfr.description: Structured NFRs (conventions.yml nfr_categories). Never free prose.
